title: Jamia orders student union polls within 15 days of constitution approval
description:
Jamia Millia Islamia on Monday ordered that students' union elections be held within 15 days of the approval of the union's constitution and revoked suspension and show-cause notices issued to students during the ongoing protest, according to an official order.
The order, issued by Registrar Md Mahtab Alam Rizvi, also provides for the constitution of a committee to inquire into the conduct of security staff during the protest period.
The decisions came after the university considered a demand letter submitted by students on hunger strike and their delegates.
